issue.title: fr.json is missing the scheduled export email strings
issue.body:
My profile language is French, and the weekly summary and password reset emails
arrive in French, but our scheduled exports always come in English: the subject
is "Scheduled export: Dépenses cartes" and the body starts "Your scheduled
export of". I think `src/i18n/fr.json` is simply missing the `email.export`
strings, so they fall back to English. Could someone add the French ones? Three
of our report owners have asked.

input.title: Send scheduled export emails in the report owner's locale
input.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

fr.json already has email.export.subject and email.export.body, so no strings are missing. runScheduledExport calls scheduledExportEmail(report, schedule.recipients, rows.length) without a locale, so the function's default of "en" always applies. Look up the report owner's (User.locale) and pass it as the fourth argument, falling back to "en" if it is unknown.
